# Connotation load (LEX003)

A word importing a register the task never asked for.

| Metadata | Value |
|---|---|
| Rule ID | `lex-connotation` |
| Family | lexical |
| Applies to | `core` |
| Default severity | `warning` |
| Fix | `manual` |
| Evidence | prac |
| Sniffers | llm |
| Contextual evaluation | LLM |

A word drags in tone the task did not ask for, nudging the output's register.

Bad:  Interrogate the config and brutally trim the output.
Good: Read the config and remove unused output.

Not a finding when the loaded word is the accurate one.

## Detector metadata

```yaml
- kind: llm
  confidence: medium
  hook_safe: false
```
